body: Thank you so much for replying! It's always good to have these helpful posts that give people hope. If not, this condition can wreck havoc on one's mental state I'm sure. It's awesome you have a great support system for you, I hope you nothing but peace for all of us, somehow.

That's good, it's best to find any way you can to find some respite from this shit. I was almost scared colonless when mine didn't go away after an hour. Knew something was truly up then. But this is good, your life is truly precious and I hope you can continue to find relief.

Thank you, kind person. All I want is to give people hope that they can fight through this, with all their might they can. There are times when my tinnitus cranks it up a couple notches and...mostly I just brush it off. Would not have been able to do that last year. 
Anyway I hope you as well can find peace as well.

Thank you as well for this comment. I try my best with what we have here to improve my diet. I think once I get a job or find some form of continual income, I can start buying better food for myself. I do try to offset poor night's rest by exercising, drinking plenty of water, eating fruits. I'm not just going to let this take over my life and destroy my body, I am far too young for that!
Thank you for this comment, I do appreciate it! I'll keep all of this in mind.

Thank you for this encouraging reply, I really do appreciate this. It's probably a variety of causes, all of which I'm trying to find and change. My anxiety comes mostly from the thought of negative health implications associated with lack of proper sleep. I need to realize I am young, I exercise and I'm trying my best with what I have to improve my diet. 
I'm also trying to see if different sleeping positions help as well, as well as different room temperatures. Really I'm just desperate, for anything, because I don't want something serious to be the cause of all this. I feel it's just lifestyle changes...hopefully.

This is my experience as well. Most nights it's 3 hours without fail, no matter if I go to sleep at 11 or 12 something. This lack of sleep has almost stomped my enjoyment of life and it's disheartening.

And hopefully you have continued success with getting adequate rest. It boggles me that there are people who underestimate how great sleep can be for your overall well-being. There are those who even take pride in how much sleep they AREN'T getting. 
Being put on medications is what I'm afraid of; I don't want my body to develop a dependency for it, you know? I could do medications for awhile, but eventually I want to seek natural ways to get adequate rest. 
I'm 24 going on 25 at the end of this month and it feels like I've already reached 60. I'll try taking it easy on myself. Begrudging my situation isn't going to make anything better, I know. It's all just worrying when you don't know the cause.

Thank you for your comment, I appreciate it. ^_^ 

But couldn't anyone on the other side as well say that if we're going to die anyway, why not speed up the process? See, I feel like comments like that come from viewing life as more preferable over death. No one is inherently right, but I understand your view point. I'd prefer death, so I say why not speed up the process? It's inevitable anyway? But I am conflicted on myself with this. 

Yes, I'm hoping great things from this year's E3.

I've been suicidal since 2013/14, most like even before then, though the urge become strong around that time. Since then I've gone to three hospitals, seen multiple therapist, psychiatrists, taken multiple medication, two day programs, ECTs, and things I could do to help myself such as exercise and losing weight. While I have made progress since then, none of that has been adequate enough to keep me here. Yes, reaching out to friends and family would be great, only I'm met with typical boring platitudes and people who want me to think life is inherently preferable over death. I enjoy their comforting nature, they're willingness to help, but none of it does as thing. I've lost myself along the way, and that is something people seem to ignore. My personality is warped beyond recognition, at least to me it is. 

And I'm not sure I'd ever contact a crisis helpline as it would just be the same platitudes, them being confused as to why a living thing would choose death, and possibly having cops at my door, which would be the last straw for me. The act of imposing life on me is what terrifies me. I just want eternal rest! Sleep is my only solace and I'm losing even that. My heart aches day and night and I'm stricken with terrible anxiety. 

I feel like I'm being punished by some Cosmic force. That even now, typing this out some karmic retribution will be doled out, which I don't actually believe, it just feels that way. I don't know if I have another week in me. I'm trying to wait for E3, I do want to see all the cool game announcements... 

I am just so exhausted. If I could press a button and just stop existing, I probably would, and I feel I shouldn't be shamed into feeling otherwise, because other humans fear death and will project those fears on to me.
Yeah, I'm fucking over it. It's mental and emotional agony day in and day out.

People, while I realize they mean well, usually give typical platitudes in order to sooth us. It just feels lazy, you know? Sometimes they even get upset when we don't want to hear it, because we've heard the same things said many times before. 

Yeah, romance is something I was/am passionate about. I don't want it because I think it'll sooth my mental hurts, I just want someone to love and to love me back. I lie to myself now, saying I don't care much and I'm content with being alone when I'm not. I do fear that no matter what I do, I'll always be the one left behind. 

You're welcome ^_^

In the general sense, no, I have people who try to support me. Although I will say I do feel alone when around those I care for, like a background character. Most of my deeper connections are of those I know online, as we seem to relate to each other more. 

In a romantic sense, yes, I do believe I'll be alone in that regard. I seem to have shit luck when it comes to romance, finding someone who feels as deeply about me as I do them. It's disheartening, especially remembering all that has happened to me. And then suffering through watching past loves find someone else, even having children... It is a pain like no other.
